one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-02 to 2026-11-01. AAOI's own Q3 report is expected Nov 5 after the close, i.e. just outside the window, so no company print falls inside it (a pre-announcement is possible but not the base case). Inside the window: hyperscaler Q3 prints and capex commentary (Microsoft/Alphabet/Meta/Amazon, roughly Oct 28-30) and peer optics prints (Celestica late Oct; Lumentum/Coherent around the start of Nov) which move AI-optics sentiment; continued selling under the $600M ATM (an overhang that caps rallies); 15% short interest that can amplify moves. The stock just rebounded ~22% in four sessions from a $94 close on Sep 28, which argues mildly for short-term mean reversion, offset by sector momentum into hyperscaler capex guidance. Net: I stay close to neutral, centring the 1-month distribution slightly below spot (median ~$114) with lognormal sigma 0.39 (139% annual vol / 3.5).

fair_value.method: Blend at the 2027-10-02 horizon: 0.6 x P/E ($3.60 NTM EPS x 25x = $90) + 0.4 x EV/sales ($3.0B NTM revenue x 3.5x + ~$0.2B net cash over ~103M diluted shares = $104) = ~$96.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS at Oct-2027 (mostly 2028) $3.60 x 25x forward P/E

inputs_detail.derivation: Consensus ~$2.57B (May) haircut ~7% for 1.6T ramp/yield risk at a new Texas plant; capacity path 650k/month end-2026 to 930k/month end-2027 supports >$2B if ASPs hold; Innolight says 2027 demand still accelerating.
Non-GAAP GM has been 29-30.5%; mgmt long-term 35-40%; I assume ~31% GM in 2027 and opex leverage, giving ~13% net margin vs 14.6% in a third-party 2027 estimate.
92.8M Q3 guidance share count plus ~5-6M shares from the $600M ATM at ~$110 plus ~4M for further dilution/SBC; company raised equity three times in 2026.
2027 EPS ~$3.0 ($2.4B x 13% / 103M); 2028 EPS ~$4.0 on ~$3.2B revenue; NTM at horizon weighted ~60% to 2028.

Peer median 36.7x (range 15.8-65.4x). Discount to median because AAOI has the lowest gross margin among optics peers (~30% vs Coherent/Lumentum 35-45%), extreme customer concentration (top-10 ~97% of revenue), serial equity dilution, and the two largest pure-play transceiver comparables (Innolight 15.8x, Eoptolink 18.7x) trade far lower with higher margins and share. 25x sits inside the range, between the Chinese pure plays and US optics names.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: NTM revenue at Oct-2027 ~$3.0B x 3.5x EV/sales + ~$0.2B net cash, / 103M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Blend of 2027 $2.4B and 2028 $3.2B; implied by 930k units/month capacity at moderating ASPs; below mgmt's >$5B annualized visibility claim.

Fabrinet 3.4x and Celestica 2.9x (low-margin builders) vs Coherent 9.5x / Ciena 9.3x (higher-margin); AAOI's ~30% GM sits closer to the builder end once current scarcity pricing normalises, so 3.5x on forward revenue.
Cash $508.8M, converts $129.1M + current debt $57.3M at Jun-30; add ATM proceeds (~$600M), subtract heavy capex ($565.5M in Q2 alone, rising in H2) leaving modest net cash.

bear.story: 1.6T ramp slips or yields disappoint at the new Texas plant; 800G ASPs fall as Innolight/Eoptolink/Coherent capacity catches up; a hyperscaler digests capex; more ATM dilution. 2027 EPS ~$1.5-2, multiple 25-30x. AAOI's 2017-18 boom-bust (stock fell >80%) is the base-rate precedent for this name.

base.story: Q3/Q4 2026 roughly meet guidance, 1.6T shipments >$70M in Q4, 2027 revenue ~$2.4B, GM ~31%; market pays ~25-30x on ~$3.6-4.0 NTM EPS; dilution continues but slows.

bull.story: Capacity reaches 930k units/month with demand exceeding supply through 2027, revenue run-rate >$4B, GM toward 35%, Amazon purchase program scales; NTM EPS ~$6-7 at ~33x, near the prior $233 high.

comps_summary.peer_range: Forward P/E 15.8x (Innolight) to 65.4x (Accelink); EV/EBITDA (trailing, forward not available from the source) 28.8x (Celestica) to 208.7x (Astera Labs).
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: 25x forward P/E: inside the range, ~32% below the 36.7x median; AAOI itself trades at ~50x forward on consensus today.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: Discount is structural rather than asserted: (1) gross margin ~30% vs 35-45% at Coherent/Lumentum and pure-play leaders, with no evidence yet of the 35-40% target; (2) top-10 customers ~97% of revenue; (3) share count up ~93% in under two years with a fresh $600M ATM; (4) the closest pure-play comparables, Innolight and Eoptolink, which have larger scale and share in 800G/1.6T, trade at 16-19x. These persist through the horizon because capacity build continues to need equity and customer concentration cannot fall quickly.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$62 (well under the March-2026 and September-2026 drawdown lows of roughly $94-109, and about half of today's price) the market would be pricing a failed 1.6T ramp, loss of a key hyperscaler or a gross-margin collapse rather than ordinary volatility. It equates to <20x on my 2027 EPS or ~2x EV/sales, levels reached only if the growth story breaks.

reasoning: Facts: Q2 2026 revenue $191.9M (+86% y/y), non-GAAP GM 29.8%, non-GAAP EPS $0.06; Q3 guide $255-290M; ~$1.1B 2026 target; capacity 650k units/month by end-2026 rising to 930k by end-2027; >$200M first 1.6T order. Alternative-lane signals: Stocktwits retail sentiment turned bearish on the third 2026 ATM ($600M, Aug 23); short interest ~15% of float; insiders sold ~$6.1M in 3 months with no buys (CFO sale Sep 11); Citrini Research's March photonics report drove a 14% one-day drop, showing the stock's sensitivity to independent-research narratives; an X trader ('Serenity') followed by retail is long from ~$28, a crowded-momentum signal; Sugar Land hiring of 500 jobs and a $20.85M state grant corroborate the physical build-out; Innolight's comments and TrendForce support 2027 demand growth. Research limits: X, the Gaetano Substack (paywalled) and Seeking Alpha articles were not readable; Google Trends and job-posting counts could not be fetched. Valuation: P/E and EV/sales blend gives ~$96 fair value vs $115.59 spot and a $139-163 sell-side mean, because I discount to the peer median for margins, concentration and dilution. Distribution: a three-lognormal mixture (bear $50 30%, base $112 45%, bull $220 25%) gives a median near $110 and a mean near $120, wide enough to match the 139% realized vol and the name's boom-bust history. The ladder is decisive at the tails (95% above $29, ~13% above $231) and slightly below 50% at spot.
